audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Test of Spirit is 'the whole matchup' but never says what to do once it lands — and there are two answers in Riot's own text.
audit.why: Riot's Test of Spirit: 'Spirits echo a percentage of the damage they take to the original target. If killed, or if the target gets too far from the spirit, the target will become a Vessel.' So running away is the losing play — distance is one of the two Vessel conditions. Killing the spirit also makes you a Vessel. What you actually do is stop damaging the spirit and stay close to it until the timer ends. The page currently tells you to 'sprint out of her field', which is one of the two things that converts you.
audit.corrected: If the spirit lands, do not run and do not kill it — running out of range makes you a Vessel just as surely as killing it does. Stay close, stop hitting it, and walk out only after it expires.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tentacles are treated as something she places anywhere. They spawn on terrain.
audit.why: Riot's Prophet of an Elder God: 'Illaoi and the Vessels she creates spawn Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain... Tentacles deal physical damage to enemies hit, and will heal Illaoi if they damage a champion.' Fighting in the open middle of the lane means fewer walls for tentacles to grow on, and every tentacle that connects is a heal for her — which is the anti-heal case _missing-interactions.json flags.
audit.corrected: Tentacles grow on impassable terrain, so fight in the open lane; each one that hits you heals her.

audit.whatIsWrong: Coverage flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere', and Harsh Lesson is never named despite being her engage.
audit.why: Test of Spirit 16s at rank 1 at 900 range, Harsh Lesson 4 seconds, Tentacle Smash 10s, Leap of Faith 120s. Harsh Lesson at 4s is the number that reframes the lane: her gap-closer is back three times per Shield Vault, so you never out-space her, you only out-time Test of Spirit's 16s.
audit.corrected: Numbers added; Harsh Lesson's 4s named as the reason spacing does not work here.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are yours, but only outside her tentacles. Your point-and-click W stun plus Q chunks her before she has any tentacles placed, so threaten the level-1 and level-2 all-in hard. The trap is committing where she's already set tentacles — if she lands E (Test of Spirit) on your spirit, you have to sprint out of her field while three tentacles slam you. Throw your held long-range Q to poke and clear from max distance, never walk into the field to melee her down.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are yours, but only away from walls — tentacles grow on impassable terrain, so the open middle of the lane is the safe half. Shield Vault's leap-stun plus Q chunks her before one exists. If Test of Spirit lands, do NOT sprint away and do NOT kill the spirit: distance and killing it are both what turn you into a Vessel. Stand near it, stop hitting it, and wait it out. Throw the held Comet Spear to poke and clear from max distance instead — never walk into a tentacle cluster to melee her down.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are where she stabilizes and the lane tips to her. Once she has a few tentacles down, every short trade you take eats multiple slams, and her sustain heals the Q poke right back. Use Aegis Assault (E) to block a tentacle wave or her vessel autos if you must fight, but your real value now is leaving — Grand Starfall (R) to a sidelane or river gank turns your early tempo into a lead somewhere you can actually convert it. At her 6, her R is a hard no-go: do not all-in into that tentacle storm even with your ult up.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 she stabilizes and the lane tips. Every tentacle that connects heals her, and Harsh Lesson is a 4-second leap, so you cannot space her — you can only time Test of Spirit's 16s. Facing her lets Aegis Assault eat a slam wave if you must fight, but your real value is leaving: a Grand Starfall roam converts your early tempo somewhere it counts. Never all-in into a fresh Leap of Faith on 120s, even with Grand Starfall up: it spawns a tentacle for every champion it hits, and each one that lands on you is another heal for her.

notes: The most dangerous line on the page was the instruction to 'sprint out of her field' after Test of Spirit lands. Riot's text: 'If killed, or if the target gets too far from the spirit, the target will become a Vessel.' Running is one of the two conversion conditions and killing the spirit is the other — so the advised play was the losing play. The correct answer, staying close and not damaging it, is now written. Second: tentacles spawn on impassable terrain, so the open lane is materially safer, and every tentacle that damages a champion heals her — neither fact was anywhere on the page. _missing-interactions.json claims Leap of Faith makes her untargetable; Riot's text for it is damage plus a tentacle per champion hit, with no untargetability or grounding, so I did not write that.
